description: Close the community engagement loop: make expert moderation reachable so submitted interventions can reach the map, restore the sensors layer whose removal premise is now false, publish evacuation-zones end to end, return review outcomes to submitters, and decide whether community submissions become ML labels

pivot_reconciliation_20260822.verdict: still valid, NOT superseded -- becomes more canonical post-pivot. §0.23.4 decision 1 retains Postgres for community features only; interventions/moderation/submissions are exactly that.

phase_status_20260822.phase_1_moderation_loop: PARTIAL. UI, role gating and tests shipped (src/components/panels/ContributionQueue.tsx, ModerationPanel.tsx, src/__tests__/security/moderation-route-access.test.tsx), most likely delivered via the later community_intervention_lifecycle_20260814 track (already archived complete; its metadata.json lists this track's spec as informed_by). reviewContribution and publishContribution are both real, distinct tRPC procedures (src/lib/server/trpc/routers/contributions.ts). But conductor/RUNBOOK.md records interventions at 2 rows, both status='approved', 0 published, as of the 2026-08-21/22 map-fix session -- the approve step runs, the publish step is never invoked by any UI path found. This is a live, confirmed gap against this phase's own acceptance criterion ('a contributor-submitted recommendation is publishable by an expert and visible on the map afterwards').
phase_status_20260822.phase_2_sensors: DONE. drizzle/0010_sensor_tile_properties.sql rewrote geo.sensor_tiles()'s SELECT list from sensor_type/status/name to network/sensor_id/station_name/observed_at, matching what the NWS producer actually writes -- the exact fix this phase's remaining item called for. Layer registered in layer-registry.ts.
phase_status_20260822.phase_3_evacuation_zones: DONE. drizzle/0009_evacuation_zone_tiles.sql shipped geo.evacuation_zone_tiles(), registered in martin.yaml.
phase_status_20260822.phase_4_review_outcomes: DONE, at a different component than the plan named. src/components/panels/CommunityDetails.tsx (not CommunityPanel.tsx, which no longer exists -- superseded by dedicated /community, /feed, /moderation routes) reads listMySubmissions and surfaces reviewNote, with a passing test (src/__tests__/components/CommunityDetails.test.tsx).
phase_status_20260822.phase_5_ml_label_bridge: Still BLOCKED on the owner's four open questions. No evidence of progress or resolution found.

pivot_reconciliation_20260822.remaining_work: One concrete defect (the approved-but-never-published intervention rows) plus the still-open Phase 5 decision. Everything else this track specified has shipped, mostly through a different, already-archived track.

dependency_mode: UI, tRPC and Drizzle only. Phase 3 adds one geo tile function (Drizzle owns geo) and one infra/martin/martin.yaml entry. No Alembic revision, no agri schema change, no DML into geo outside the existing submission path. Does not touch the Python ingestion CLI except where phase 5 reads from it.
activation_gate: Phase 1 is the ordering constraint: interventions is the one layer that is deliberately empty and must stay that way until a real contributor submits. No phase in this track may seed an intervention row (owner directive 2026-08-04). Phases 2 and 3 are independent of phase 1 and of each other. Phase 5 is design-gated and must not start until its open questions are answered by the owner.
